recommended_first_subject.note: Delfi Pro is an adjustable foam/fabric/strap system. For a FIRST photo-to-avatar reconstruction, prefer a rigid, opaque, matte, distinctly-featured subject. Fix all adjustments before capture and photograph the seat in ONE frozen configuration, or start with a rigid catalogue accessory (moulded shell, tray/table, rigid base) that satisfies the controlled-capture contract. See docs/ANATOMIC-SITT-PHOTO-CAPTURE-GUIDE.md.
capture_friendly: rigid moulded seat shell in fixed config
capture_hostile: dominant transparent or highly reflective surfaces

reference_identity_public.note: These are real, published registry values used to ground the target. The exact SKU/variant of the physical unit Oskar photographs MUST be confirmed at capture time and written into the runtime job.

published_specs.internal_width_note: If internal width is adjustable, value is the maximum internal width.

dimensions_mm.measurement_policy: Oskar measures W/D/H of the exact physical unit in mm with a tape at capture time; registry internal-width is NOT the full envelope and is not a substitute.

rights.note: Anatomic SITT AB is Oskar's family firm (brother-in-law is CEO). Rights are instantly clearable via one signed internal authorization — the cheapest exact G3 rights path in the corpus. No manufacturer cold-outreach needed. The signed authorization is the evidence_ref the pipeline requires; until it exists, redistribution stays review and generated output stays runtime-only.

avatar_plan.geometry: multi-view photo reconstruction of the exact owned physical unit (Meshy multi-image), scale-constrained by measured W/H/D
avatar_plan.appearance: exact captured materials of the real unit; no generated recolouring
avatar_plan.scale_gate: each axis within 3% of measured W/D/H (photo-avatar-qa-contract)
avatar_plan.identity_gate: exact SKU/variant of the captured unit confirmed and written into the job before any exact-product claim

blockers: capture 5 cleared views (front/rear/left/right/three_quarter) of the exact owned unit, plus extra orbit frames for QA
measure and record W/D/H in mm with evidence_ref
sign the family-firm reconstruction+render authorization and attach it as rights evidence_ref
confirm the exact SKU/variant of the captured unit and set identity_state=verified
run preflight PASS, generate with MESHY_API_KEY, pass multi-view QA, obtain human acceptance

next_gates_beyond_g3: engineering-interface authority (mounting/adjustment interfaces) for any G4 claim — photo capture alone never grants this
manufacturer CAD/spec cross-check if available internally
